purpose: T09 photon likelihood as a development binding in Python, recipe reco.light.channel-likelihood/1 (decisions.md, U12 A; not a native backend, whose gap stays open), stage 1: the readout light-readout/1 (per channel the state live-hit, live-unhit, dead or disabled, the charge, the first time and the readout's saturated flag, side by side), the charge-only all-channel likelihood of the hep-detector photon-likelihood reference on the stated analytic light model of t04-values-v4.md section 4.3 (every live channel; hit and no-hit terms on one threshold model, so their probabilities sum to one per channel, checked at the reported point; saturated channels censored; dead and disabled channels excluded, never unhit), a fit from one seed for vertex, direction and visible energy with the inverse observed Hessian as its uncertainty, the product light-likelihood-product/1 with a reader that refuses a malformed or incomplete product and recomputes ln L and the probability check, and on the scoring side the harness that hands out the frozen generator t09-sphere/1's events as files and the development readings; every result labelled shared-model closure; optional, required by no skill

tools.name: photon-likelihood development binding (Python with NumPy and SciPy)

status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; proposed until a job of record runs it and VALIDATION.md records the run; hand-made events on the login node only so far; shared-model closure, which tests the code, not the light model; no photon-likelihood quality claim
